headline: Eleven. The cloud begins to leak.
body: A thin rain is on the glass now, not a downpour — just the cover spending a little of itself. Seventeen degrees, west-southwest still at thirteen, the air close and slightly colder than it looks. The street takes it without comment; puddles have not formed yet.
